يمتنعون (form VIII)
# يَمْتَنِعُونَ (yamtaniʕūna) /jam.ta.ni.ʕuː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِمْتَنَعَ (imtanaʕa)
# يُمْتَنَعُونَ (yumtanaʕūna) /jum.ta.na.ʕuː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِمْتَنَعَ (imtanaʕa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
